title: TripExtraction
description: Structured trip data extracted from travel text. Field design notes: field_notes.md

destination.description: The city or region of the whole trip, e.g. 'Singapore'

dates.description: Calendar dates explicitly stated in the text, format YYYY-MM-DD. If the text only says Day 1 / Day 2 with no real dates, return an empty array. Never invent a year.

places.description: Every place mentioned in the text

name.description: Place name only, never a whole sentence. Max 255 chars to match the backend draft_place.name column.

type.description: Place category. Must be exactly one of the five enum values.

coords.description: Latitude and longitude. Travel text almost never contains coordinates. Never invent them: always return null here. Real coordinates are filled in later by a geocoding step.

activities.description: What the traveller does at this place
